[SWS_DM_01971] FDC value for monitors without debouncing
⌈
If a monitor was
initialised by ara::diag::Monitor::Monitor or , ara::diag::MultipleMon-
itor::ConfigureMonitor the DM shall derive the FDC value by the following rules:
• -128 in case TestFailed=0 and TestNotCompletedThisCycle = 0
• 0 in case TestNotCompletedThisCycle = 1
• 127 in case TestFailed=1 and TestNotCompletedThisCycle = 0." ⌋
